title: Report product count by brand

expectedResponse.message: No product/report endpoint is defined in the supplied Swagger; this SQL case remains a database-only validation.

sqlValidation:
SELECT brand, COUNT(*) AS productCount
FROM dbo.Products
GROUP BY brand
ORDER BY productCount DESC;
sqlExpectedResult: Counts accurately represent products by brand.
